title: Ismaël Lajaaiti
text:
I am a postdoctoral researcher at INRAE, based in the DECOD lab in Rennes, France.
My work combines data analysis, statistics, and theoretical modeling to address fundamental questions in ecology. In particular, I have sustaine interest in network ecology, species and community stability, and the development of open-source tools in R and Julia.
You can have a look at my research projects and my publications. You can also retrieve my work on google scholar and have a look at my resume.
Feel free to reach at ismael.lajaaiti[at]inrae.fr.
